scoring_justification: Decomposition enthalpy and Gibbs free energy are recomputed from static_enthalpies.csv and gibbs_free_energies.csv; bandgap compared to paper's reported values.

outputs.description: Decomposition enthalpy ΔH at 65 GPa and positivity across the pressure range will be recomputed from these data.
Decomposition Gibbs free energy ΔG at 65 GPa and 2500 K will be recomputed from these data.
Thermal and optical bandgaps compared to the computed reference values.

output_contract.notes: All output files are read by the hidden checker. The checker recomputes decomposition enthalpy and Gibbs free energy from the tables using the known reference phases, and compares bandgaps within tolerance. No gold values are exposed.

steps.description: Recompute ΔH(65 GPa) from static enthalpies and compare to paper's +0.64 eV.
Check that the lowest-enthalpy CaO₂ phase at selected pressures matches the paper's sequence.
Verify that ΔH > 0 across the computed pressure range.
Recompute ΔG(65 GPa, 2500 K) from Gibbs free energies and compare to paper's +0.54 eV.
Verify that ΔG > 0 for the mantle condition (65 GPa, 2500 K).
Compare thermal and optical bandgaps to paper's reported 2.4 and 2.5 eV.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for decomposition enthalpy, Gibbs free energy, bandgaps, and phase sequence
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text and Table I, Fig. 1, Fig. 3
hidden_assets.generation_method: directly taken from paper reported values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are the paper's own reported numeric results
